scope: Final visual acceptance of the self-contained file:// offline text, exercises and choice projection only; not live product acceptance or a source/math/answer review.

criteria.layout: pass: Titles, numbered rows, figures, fieldsets and captions remain separated and contained at both viewports; no visible overlap or clipped content.
criteria.formulas: pass: Greek letters, vector notation, intersections, perpendicular/parallel signs, subscripts, radicals and fractions render legibly without visible error placeholders. Mathematical correctness was not re-reviewed.
criteria.readability: pass: Prose and options retain readable contrast and line spacing; mobile wraps preserve complete content and figure labels remain readable.
criteria.navigation_regions: pass: Text-to-exercises and exercises-to-text buttons are visible, unobscured and confirmed by the authoritative checker. The checker-generated choice projection intentionally replaces the sheet and contains no navigation; no live-product navigation claim is made.
criteria.option_controls: pass: All six choice questions have visible single-choice legends, four separated radio options and a visible selected second option. Mutual exclusivity and selection are proven by the authoritative checker.

screenshots.observations: Centered reading column; proof notation is clear. Figures 123 and 124, labels and captions are unobscured. The bottom exercise navigation region is separated from the prose.
Exercises 305-309 retain a distinct number gutter and separated rows. Inline mathematics and subparts fit the column. The return navigation button is fully visible below the last exercise.

Six question regions and their fieldsets are separated. Question 2's condition/conclusion table remains readable. Long option prose, fractions and radicals fit their fields. Radio controls and selected states are visible.

The title wraps cleanly onto two lines. The proof and vector notation wrap without collisions. Both complete figures and their captions remain readable inside the narrow column. The bottom navigation button is unobscured.
Exercise numbers remain distinct from wrapped bodies. Formula groups, measurements and subparts stay contained and readable. The final exercise and return navigation region have clear separation.

All six question blocks and four-option fieldsets are visible and complete. Question 2's table wraps within its two columns without overlap. Long options wrap within the fieldsets; selected radios remain easy to locate. Question 4 has standalone terminal punctuation on some wrapped options, noted as nonblocking polish.

nonblocking_observations.description: Terminal punctuation wraps onto a separate line after some formula options. The complete formula, units and control remain visible and readable.
